sentences.arabic: اِشْتَرَيْتُ تُفَّاحًا وَمَوْزًا مِنَ السُّوقِ
sentences.transliteration: ishtaraytu tuffaa7an wa mawzan mina as-sooq

sentences.arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُقَشِّرَ لِي هَذِهِ الْبُرْتُقَالَةَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal yumkinuka an tuqashshira lee haadhihi al-burtuqaala?

sentences.arabic: نَأْكُلُ الْبِطِّيخَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِي الصَّيْفِ
sentences.transliteration: na2kulu al-bitteekha kulla yawmin fee as-sayf

sentences.arabic: نُفْطِرُ عَلَى التَّمْرِ وَالْمَاءِ
sentences.transliteration: nuftiru 3alaa at-tamri wal-maa2

sentences.arabic: هَذَا الْعِنَبُ حُلْوٌ جِدًّا
sentences.transliteration: haadhaa al-3inabu 7ulwun jiddaa

sentences.arabic: هَذِهِ الْكُمَّثْرَى عَفِنَةٌ، اِرْمِهَا
sentences.transliteration: haadhihi al-kummathraa 3afinatun, irmihaa

sentences.arabic: قَطِّعِ الْبَصَلَ وَالثُّومَ قِطَعًا صَغِيرَةً
sentences.transliteration: qatti3i al-basala wath-thooma qita3an sagheera

sentences.arabic: نَحْتَاجُ إِلَى طَمَاطِمَ وَخِيَارٍ لِلسَّلَطَةِ
sentences.transliteration: na7taaju ilaa tamaatima wa khiyaarin lis-salata

sentences.arabic: ضَعِ الْبَطَاطِسَ فِي الْفُرْنِ سَاعَةً
sentences.transliteration: da3i al-bataatisa fee al-furni saa3a

sentences.arabic: هَلْ تُرِيدُ نَعْنَاعًا فِي شَايِكَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal tureedu na3naa3an fee shaayik?

sentences.arabic: أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ حَسَاءَ الْعَدَسِ فِي الشِّتَاءِ
sentences.transliteration: ummee tatbukhu 7asaa2a al-3adasi fee ash-shitaa2

sentences.arabic: لَا أُحِبُّ الْبَاذِنْجَانَ، لَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ الْبَامِيَةَ كَثِيرًا
sentences.transliteration: laa u7ibbu al-baadhinjaana, laakinnee u7ibbu al-baamiyata katheeraa

sentences.arabic: نَحْتَاجُ إِلَى كِيلُو مِنَ الْأَرُزِّ وَقَلِيلٍ مِنَ الدَّقِيقِ
sentences.transliteration: na7taaju ilaa keeloo mina al-aruzzi wa qaleelin mina ad-daqeeq

sentences.arabic: آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ مَعَ الْجُبْنِ وَزَيْتِ الزَّيْتُونِ
sentences.transliteration: aakulu al-khubza ma3a al-jubni wa zayti az-zaytoon

sentences.arabic: يَشْرَبُ الْأَطْفَالُ الْحَلِيبَ كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ
sentences.transliteration: yashrabu al-atfaalu al-7aleeba kulla sabaa7

sentences.arabic: الْعَسَلُ مَعَ الزَّبَادِي طَيِّبٌ جِدًّا لِلْفُطُورِ
sentences.transliteration: al-3asalu ma3a az-zabaadee tayyibun jiddan lil-futoor

sentences.arabic: ضَعْ قَلِيلًا مِنَ الْفُسْتُقِ وَاللَّوْزِ فَوْقَهَا
sentences.transliteration: da3 qaleelan mina al-fustuqi wal-lawzi fawqahaa

sentences.arabic: أَضِفْ قَلِيلًا مِنَ الْكَمُّونِ وَالْقِرْفَةِ إِلَى اللَّحْمِ
sentences.transliteration: adif qaleelan mina al-kammooni wal-qirfati ilaa al-la7m

sentences.arabic: هَلْ تُرِيدُ دَجَاجًا أَمْ سَمَكًا لِلْعَشَاءِ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal tureedu dajaajan am samakan lil-3ashaa2?

sentences.arabic: أُرِيدُ شَطِيرَتَيْ شَاوِرْمَا بِدُونِ بَصَلٍ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: ureedu shateeratay shaawirmaa bidooni basalin, min fadlik

sentences.arabic: نَصْنَعُ الْكُفْتَةَ مِنَ اللَّحْمِ الْمَفْرُومِ وَالْبَقْدُونِسِ
sentences.transliteration: nasna3u al-kuftata mina al-la7mi al-mafroomi wal-baqdoonis

sentences.arabic: بَعْدَ الْعَشَاءِ أَكَلْنَا الْكُنَافَةَ
sentences.transliteration: ba3da al-3ashaa2i akalnaa al-kunaafa

sentences.arabic: نَأْكُلُ دَائِمًا الزَّيْتُونَ وَالْعُجَّةَ فِي الْفُطُورِ
sentences.transliteration: na2kulu daa2iman az-zaytoona wal-3ujjata fee al-futoor

sentences.arabic: الْيَخْنَةُ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى مِلْحٍ وَفُلْفُلٍ أَسْوَدَ أَكْثَرَ
sentences.transliteration: al-yakhnatu ta7taaju ilaa mil7in wa fulfulin aswada akthar
